audit_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	case_id VARCHAR(80), 
	event_type VARCHAR(120), 
	event_message TEXT, 
	event_payload_json TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

bid_recommendations.sql:
CREATE TABLE bid_recommendations (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	case_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	total_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	percentage FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	recommendation VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	rationale TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

bid_scorecard.sql:
CREATE TABLE bid_scorecard (

	case_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	score INTEGER NOT NULL,

cases.sql:
CREATE TABLE cases (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	case_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	client_name VARCHAR(255), 
	organization VARCHAR(255), 
	contact_person VARCHAR(255), 
	email VARCHAR(255), 
	whatsapp VARCHAR(80), 
	tender_title VARCHAR(500), 
	donor_client VARCHAR(255), 
	country VARCHAR(120), 
	sector VARCHAR(120), 
	submission_deadline VARCHAR(80), 
	submission_type VARCHAR(120), 
	bidding_role VARCHAR(120), 
	diagnostic_type VARCHAR(120), 
	status VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	payment_status VARCHAR(80), 
	readiness_label VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

egp_checklist_items.sql:
